(402)329-6335

Office Hours
8:30 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.
Monday – Friday
Open through the lunch hour
Closed Weekends and Holidays
Location
111 W. Court St., Room 4
Pierce, NE 68767
Treasurer Office
The treasurer receives all the money belonging to the county and all money which is directed to her by the law. The treasurer must prepare and file the annual inventory statement of the county personal property in her possession. The treasurer shall also invest bond money for cities and villages. Upon her discretion, the treasurer may appoint a deputy, who cannot be the county clerk, sheriff, register of deeds or surveyor. Open Mon-Fri 8:30 to 4:30.
Duties
To collect all revenues for the County
To bill and collect all real estate and personal taxes in the County
Register all motor vehicles and boats with tax situs in the County
To disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
Title all motor vehicles and boats with situs in the county
Boat Registration
Snowmobile Registration
DMV Services is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the Treasurer Office.
